text:
sara.sales: FYI — Vantage Therapeutics sent an RFI. They want a capability matrix, answers to the security questionnaire, and a short two-track POC plan (VPC private deploy + air-gapped appliance). POC window = 4 weeks. Key asks: dedicated capacity, customer-managed KMS/HSM, EU data residency (eu-west-1). PDF attached below.

josh-se: Copy. Do we have target concurrency/seq lengths? need to size GPUs and call out perf delta for air-gapped.

sara.sales: They listed ~150 concurrent sessions peak, avg prompt 65 tokens, avg response 180 tokens. Latency target p50 <= 300ms, p95 <= 700ms.

josh-se: Baseline rec: 2 x A100-equivalent GPUs for dedicated; autoscale to 3 for headroom. Air-gapped likely needs higher spec or relaxed p95. I'll draft matrix with SLOs and notes.

maya-ops: For on-prem appliance: they flagged "air-gapped friendly" and FIPS option. We should include both installer flows: 1) VPC-connected private control plane, 2) offline appliance image + manual key injection.

build-bot: Compliance snapshot: SOC2-TypeII=YES, ISO27001=PARTIAL, FedRAMP=NO, KMS-integration=SUPPORTED, HSM-attestation=partner-certs. Templates at /sales/rfps/templates.

tim-csm: Action item: get written acceptance criteria from customer (throughput tests, KMS integration demo, audit log verification). I'll request that in kickoff.

rachel-legal: We'll need a DPA + air-gapped addendum clarifying key custody, support SLA for offline installs, and a data destruction attestation. Also check if they require subprocessor list.

maya-ops: Teardown plan: include data-destruction checklist, signed verification block, and SHA256 manifest template for transferred artifacts. Air-gap notes: USB checksum procedure, manual key injection steps (example commands).

josh-se: Quick draft matrix snippet (CSV) to include in RFI response:
```
feature,hosted,dedicated,private-vpc,air-gapped
concurrent-sessions,900,2400,150,150
p50-latency,95ms,80ms,140ms,210ms
p95-latency,430ms,310ms,580ms,820ms
kms-mode,managed,customer,connector,hsm-offline
data-residency,global,region-pinned,region-pinned,onsite-only
```

sara.sales: Good. Josh/Maya/Rachel — please prepare: (1) full RFP capability matrix table, (2) 2-page POC runbook for both tracks (install steps, smoke tests, perf script), (3) teardown + data destruction checklist with manifest template, (4) DPA redline. I'll schedule kickoff with Vantage infra for Thu 11:00 UTC.

josh-se: ETA for matrix + runbook: tomorrow EOD. Note: call out perf risk in air-gapped mode if they insist on p95 < 600ms.

maya-ops: ETA for teardown + manifest + offline install doc: EOD today. Flag: FIPS-only build adds ~10 business days.

rachel-legal: I'll upload a DPA redline and add clause for customer-managed HSM responsibilities.

tim-csm: I'll try to capture acceptance criteria on the kickoff and push for a written signoff template we can attach.

build-bot: Reminder: attach Vantage_RFI.pdf and Vantage_SecQ_v1.pdf to thread assets. Use /sales/rfps/templates/billing-hook.csv if they want per-token cost reporting during POC.

sara.sales: Attachments uploaded and invite sent. Flag any blockers before kickoff. :thumbsup:
